cards.english_title: Judge Ends Trump’s Lawsuit Over Epstein Report
cards.korean_desc: 게일스 판사는 트럼프가 악의를 입증하지 못했다고 말했다 트럼프는 엡스타인 편지 보도로 100억 달러를 청구했다 기각은 확정적이어서 트럼프는 소송을 고칠 수 없다
cards.english_desc: Judge Darrin Gayles said Trump failed to show actual malice by the defendants. Trump sought $10 billion over a report about an alleged birthday letter to Jeffrey Epstein. The dismissal was with prejudice, so Trump cannot amend this lawsuit.
cards.hook: A judge dismissed Trump’s $10 billion lawsuit.
cards.takeaway_english: The case is over in this court, but the wider political argument continues.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이 법정 소송은 끝났지만 정치 논쟁은 계속된다

why_it_matters.english: The ruling limits one legal route for challenging media coverage.
why_it_matters.korean: 판결은 언론 보도에 맞서는 법적 길을 제한한다

why_it_matters.english: The case keeps attention on the release of Epstein-related records.

views.korean: 트럼프 측은 잘못을 부인하고 법정에서 보도에 맞섰다

cards.english_title: Trump Says One or Two Iranian Targets Remain
cards.korean_desc: 트럼프는 2026년 10월 31일 표적 한두 곳을 말했다 그는 픽액스 산을 말했고 이란은 부인했다 10월 31일 이란은 즉각 대응을 경고했다 카타르와 파키스탄이 중재하지만 합의는 없다
cards.english_desc: Trump said on October 31, 2026, that one or two Iranian targets remained. He named Pickaxe Mountain, while Iran denies nuclear work occurs there. On October 31, Iran threatened an immediate response without geographic limits. Qatar and Pakistan are mediating, but talks have not produced a lasting agreement.
cards.hook: Trump says one or two targets remain.
cards.korean_hook: 트럼프는 표적 한두 곳이 남았다고 말했다
cards.takeaway_english: Talks continue, but threats around Iran and Hormuz keep the risk of escalation high.

why_it_matters.english: The blockade has already pushed global energy prices higher.
why_it_matters.korean: 봉쇄는 이미 세계 에너지 가격을 올렸다

parties.label: Iran

parties.korean: 이란은 광범위한 대응과 호르무즈 조건을 말한다

parties.label: Mediators
parties.english: Qatar and Pakistan are trying to mediate, but no lasting agreement exists.

views.korean: 루비오는 새 공격을 결정하지 않았고 외교에 열려 있다고 말했다

cards.english_title: Pope Leo Votes in America While Leading Vatican City
cards.korean_desc: 바티칸은 그가 미국 시민으로 투표한다고 말했다 그의 시민권과 바티칸시국 주권은 다르다 바티칸은 레오가 페루에서도 투표했다고 말했다
cards.english_desc: The Vatican says he votes whenever he is eligible as a United States citizen. His citizenship remains separate from his sovereignty over Vatican City. The Vatican also said Leo voted while eligible during his earlier residence in Peru.
cards.hook: Pope Leo voted by mail in Chicago.
cards.takeaway_english: Leo’s vote is unusual, but the Vatican presents it as ordinary civic participation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 레오의 투표는 이례적이지만 바티칸은 시민 참여라고 설명한다

why_it_matters.korean: 사례는 시민권과 국가 지도자의 역할을 구분하게 한다

why_it_matters.english: It shows how voting rights can continue after a major public appointment.
why_it_matters.korean: 큰 공직 뒤에도 투표권이 계속될 수 있음을 보여준다

parties.label: Pope Leo XIV
parties.english: He remains a U.S. citizen and has voted whenever eligible.
parties.korean: 그는 미국 시민이며 자격이 있을 때 투표했다

parties.label: The Vatican
parties.english: The Holy See confirmed his mail-in ballot as civic participation.
parties.korean: 교황청은 그의 우편투표를 시민 참여로 확인했다

parties.label: U.S. voters
parties.english: They are choosing Congress in the November 3 midterm elections.

views.label: Vatican
views.english: The Vatican says citizenship and civic participation allow Leo to vote.
views.korean: 바티칸은 시민권과 참여가 투표를 허용한다고 말한다

views.label: Political observers
views.english: Observers may see the vote as unusual because the pope leads another sovereign state.

cards.english_title: Arab Parties Surge and Could Shape Israel’s Next Government
cards.korean_desc: 투표율은 77.7퍼센트로 1999년 이후 최고였다 공동명부는 11석, 라암은 8석을 얻었다 아랍 진영은 연정에 영향력을 줄 수 있다
cards.english_desc: Turnout reached 77.7 percent, the highest since 1999, according to exit-poll reporting. The Joint List won 11 seats, while Ra’am won eight. The Arab bloc could influence coalition talks, but no side has welcomed it into government.
cards.takeaway_english: The surge gives Arab parties more seats, but seats alone do not guarantee power.
